card.title: First Free Slot for Two Calendars

a1.cap: Two people's busy times a and b are sorted, non-overlapping intervals [start, end). Within the working day [day_start, day_end), return the earliest slot [t, t + duration] when both are free, or [] if none exists.
a1.say: Two people's busy times a and b are sorted, non-overlapping intervals start, end). Within the working day day start, day end), return the earliest slot t, t plus duration when both are free, or if none exists.

lines: Two people's busy times a and b are sorted, non-overlapping intervals [start, end). Within the working day [day_start, day_end), return the earliest slot [t, t + duration] when both are free, or [] if none exists.

a1.cap: For example, with a = [[9,10],[12,13]], b = [[9,11],[14,15]], day_start = 9, day_end = 17, duration = 1, the answer is [11,12].
a1.say: For example, with a equals 9, 10, 12, 13, b equals 9, 11, 14, 15, day start equals 9, day end equals 17, duration equals 1, the answer is 11, 12.

a1.cap: Walk both busy lists like a merge, always taking the interval that starts first. Keep free_from, the moment everyone is free again.
a1.say: Walk both busy lists like a merge, always taking the interval that starts first. Keep free from, the moment everyone is free again.

a1.cap: If the next busy interval starts at least duration after free_from, that gap is the answer. Otherwise push free_from past it. At the end, check the gap before the day ends.
a1.say: If the next busy interval starts at least duration after free from, that gap is the answer. Otherwise push free from past it. At the end, check the gap before the day ends.

a1.cap: Let's walk through it with a = [[9,10],[12,13]], b = [[9,11],[14,15]], day_start = 9, day_end = 17, duration = 1.
a1.say: Let's walk through it with a equals 9, 10, 12, 13, b equals 9, 11, 14, 15, day start equals 9, day end equals 17, duration equals 1.

a1.cap: Busy [9, 10): everyone is free again at 10.
a1.say: Busy 9, 10): everyone is free again at 10.

a1.cap: Busy [9, 11): everyone is free again at 11.
a1.say: Busy 9, 11): everyone is free again at 11.

a1.cap: Time complexity is O(n + m) and extra space is O(1).
a1.say: Time complexity is O of n plus m and extra space is O of one.

a1.cap: That's the Two-Pointer Merge approach. Now try writing it yourself, in Java or Python!
